runSummary: No complete storyboard was accepted by the experimental repeated semantic-review gate. All three exhausted bounded quality repairs. crossChannelFinding: The experiment exposed reviewer unreliability: it sometimes recommended removing the original degree topic or fabricating curricular evidence. Repeated critique was therefore replaced by one advisory rewrite in the subsequent implementation. Neither a model rejection nor a model acceptance is an independent editorial score.
